content.title: Carrier Escalation | Continuous Motion Rises from Ground to Sky
content.summary: Keep one original clearly adult protagonist moving continuously along one established direction. Use at least four locomotion states whose carrier, contact surface or scale changes, but require every change to occur at a visible physical threshold and inherit the previous velocity, body posture or wake. Escalate monotonically from ground contact to water surface, larger living or mechanical support, and finally increased height. Never reset the adult identity or movement axis between states. End with a brief elevated release that still preserves the same silhouette.

quick_start.input_format: Lock one clearly adult original identity and one forward movement direction before the first handoff. + Trigger every carrier change at a visible physical threshold such as an edge, wake, contact or launch. + Carry at least one velocity, posture or wake cue through every transition. + Escalate surface, carrier scale or height monotonically across at least four states. + End with the same adult silhouette released at the highest scale or altitude.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open on one original clearly adult desert courier with a cobalt scarf sandboarding left to right along a marked dune ridge; establish the adult face, scarf and forward velocity. The wind-skiff passes beneath an original four-legged weather walker. The adult grabs one low handle and transfers upward while the skiff wake, body lean and left-to-right direction continue. The balloon clears the shelf and releases the same adult on a short controlled glider arc against open sky; keep cobalt scarf and adult silhouette readable, hold briefly, and use no source rider, boards, sea creatures or coast.

creative_dna.mechanism: Keep one original clearly adult protagonist moving continuously along one established direction. Use at least four locomotion states whose carrier, contact surface or scale changes, but require every change to occur at a visible physical threshold and inherit the previous velocity, body posture or wake. invariants.rule: Lock one clearly adult original identity and one forward movement direction before the first handoff.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing identity or direction makes separate clips rather than one route.

invariants.rule: Trigger every carrier change at a visible physical threshold such as an edge, wake, contact or launch.
invariants.purpose: Gives each transition a causal bridge.
invariants.ablation_failure: Open morphs or arbitrary cuts break motion inheritance.

invariants.rule: Carry at least one velocity, posture or wake cue through every transition.
invariants.purpose: Proves that movement continues rather than restarts.
invariants.ablation_failure: A stationary incoming carrier resets momentum.

invariants.rule: Escalate surface, carrier scale or height monotonically across at least four states.
invariants.ablation_failure: Randomly shrinking or returning to earlier states weakens the payoff.

invariants.rule: End with the same adult silhouette released at the highest scale or altitude.
invariants.purpose: Completes the ladder while preserving identity.
invariants.ablation_failure: An anonymous landscape or different rider loses the route.
